**STEP 2 – Vessels:** Three small bowls, estimated at 15 cm diameter each (area ≈177 cm²), and two plates at about 20 cm each (area ≈314 cm²).

**STEP 3 – Items:** Mixed fruit; mixed vegetables; boiled potatoes; chicken; cooked rice; vegetables in the rice; a small amount of oil or sauce.

**STEP 4 – Area:** Fruit covers about 45% of its bowl; vegetables 40%; potatoes 28%; chicken 35%. On the rice plate, rice covers about 48%, vegetables 15%, and sauce/oil about 2%—about 65% total.

Chicken: 110 × 1.5 ≈165 ml × 0.95 ≈157 g. Rice: 151 × 2 ≈302 ml × 0.8 ≈242 g. Rice vegetables: 47 × 2 ≈94 ml × 0.6 ≈56 g. Sauce/oil: about 6 g.

**STEP 8 – Sanity check:** The combined estimate is plausible for the visible portions across all five dishes.
